data.title: RES Shareholders Approve Project to Transfer Listing to Euronext Milan
data.description:
Recupero Etico Sostenibile S.p.A ( (IT:RES) ) has shared an announcement.

Shareholders approved the project to transfer RES’s ordinary shares from Euronext Growth Milan to Euronext Milan, with possible admission to the Euronext STAR Milan segment if requirements are met. They also approved meeting rules and revised Articles of Association provisions for regulated-market issuers, including enhanced voting rights and authority for a capital increase.

Subject to trading commencing on Euronext Milan, directors will receive fixed annual gross remuneration of €20,000 each, and PwC will replace BDO as independent auditor for 2026–2034. Two statutory auditors resigned over independence requirements under the Corporate Governance Code, with alternate auditors Meri Pellegrino and Luca Pacifico appointed until the next Shareholders’ Meeting.

data.title: INLIF Amends Warrants, Sets Series B Exercise Price at $0.30
data.description:
The latest update is out from INLIF LIMITED ( (INLF) ).

On November 18, 2026, INLIF Limited and the holders mutually agreed to amend the reset provisions of its Series B warrants. The amendment replaced the previously determined reset price of $0.51 per Unit with $0.30 per Unit, effective November 17, 2026, while leaving the initial exercise price unchanged and proportionately increasing the number of issuable Units so the aggregate exercise price remained equal to that on the October 20 issuance date.

Following the amendment, Series B warrants were exercisable for 12,500,001 Units, compared with 7,352,943 previously. Series A warrants issued upon exercise of Series B warrants carry an exercise price of $0.30 per Ordinary Share, while Series A warrants issued on October 20 had their reset price amended to $0.30 per Ordinary Share with proportionately increased share amounts; the Series B warrants had an unchanged expiration date of December 21, 2026, and other terms remained unchanged.

data.title: Banco Santander Brasil Plans Oct. 28 Release of 3Q26 Financial Statements
data.description:
The latest update is out from Banco Santander Brasil ( (BSBR) ).

Banco Santander (Brasil) S.A. is a Brazilian bank headquartered in São Paulo. The release presented performance commentary and condensed consolidated financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IAS 34.

The commentary described clearer signs of a Brazilian slowdown in 3Q26, including 0.5% second-quarter GDP growth, slower credit and weaker household consumption, as the effects of restrictive monetary policy became more evident. It also reported easing inflation alongside elevated services inflation and deteriorating longer-term expectations, while global oil volatility and higher long-term interest rates contributed to tighter financial conditions.

data.title: Wix Files Notice for December 23, 2026 Annual General Meeting
data.description:
An announcement from Wix ( (WIX) ) is now available.

On November 18, 2026, Wix filed notice of its 2026 annual general meeting, scheduled for December 23, 2026, in Tel Aviv. Shareholders of record as of November 23, 2026, will be entitled to vote in person or by proxy.

Proposals include re-electing three Class I directors, approving co-chief executive officer compensation and amended executive and director compensation policies, and ratifying the appointment and compensation of Kost, Forer, Gabbay & Kasierer, a member of Ernst & Young Global, as the independent registered public accounting firm for 2026. Wix’s board unanimously recommended voting for each proposal.

data.title: Ata Temiz Enerji Enters Agreements with Nuclean and BA Steel
data.description:
ATP Yazilim ve Teknoloji AS ( (TR:ATATP) ) has issued an announcement.

Nuclean operates in engineering, project development, technical consultancy, and technology and sustainability solutions for nuclear and clean-energy technologies. BA Steel provides engineering, manufacturing and installation services for the nuclear energy, defence and wind energy sectors.

Ata Temiz Enerji, whose founding shareholders include ATP Capital with a 45.10% stake, entered separate agreements with Nuclean, BA Steel and their shareholders on 18 November 2026. The disclosure links the investments to Türkiye’s objectives in nuclear energy and defence and to growing demand for next-generation nuclear and clean-energy technologies.

data.title: Goldgroup Mining Reports Multi-Asset Drilling and Technical Work
data.description:
Goldgroup Mining ( (TSE:GORO) ) has provided an update.

On Nov. 6, 2026, Goldgroup Mining reported drilling, exploration and technical studies across its four 100%-owned precious-metals assets in Mexico and the United States. Work included a 26,000-metre San Francisco drilling program and mine-planning studies, resource replacement and regional exploration at Don David, sonic drilling tied to Cerro Prieto heap re-leaching, and a Back Forty feasibility study.

At Don David, the company said it had completed approximately 25,726 metres in 123 holes during the first seven months of 2026, with more than 97% directed to resource definition and expansion; at Cerro Prieto, 26 of 45 sonic holes totaling 1,009 of 1,554 metres had been drilled. The update described work spanning production, exploration and development, with stated objectives including resource growth or replacement, mine planning and mine-life opportunities.

data.title: Kalyon Güneş Reports 75,000-Share Buy-Back
data.description:
Kalyon Gunes Teknolojileri Uretim Anonim Sirketi ( (TR:KLYPV) ) has shared an announcement.

Kalyon Güneş Teknolojileri Üretim A.Ş. reported that it repurchased 75,000 Class B KLYPV shares on Borsa İstanbul on November 18 under a buy-back program initiated pursuant to a board resolution dated October 19. The shares were bought at prices ranging from TRY 49.72 to TRY 51.30, with an average price of TRY 50.516.

Following buy-backs conducted under a December 9, 2025 board resolution, the company’s holdings reached a nominal TRY 4,869,522, equal to 1.058% of share capital. The program covers up to 5 million shares and a maximum payment of TRY 300 million, with the company stating that its purposes include supporting stable share-price formation, protecting shareholder interests and ensuring the price reflects operational performance.
